name: BACH_0377
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (84%)** · Confident · Read in turn
InSitu is alone in the 90% conformal set [F1], with 16% invasive risk, tier-4 priority, and ER stain drafted.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | InSitu 84%, Invasive 16%, Benign 0%, Normal 0% | Favors InSitu; residual invasive risk |
| Conformal set | {InSitu} (alpha 10%; 90% dataset coverage, n=132) | Single class at 90% guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 94th OOD percentile, 12/12 regions kept [F6] | Passes QC; atypical embedding percentile |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class (true) | Independent foundation models agree |
| Similar cases | 3/5 InSitu (60%) [F5]; 2/5 Invasive (up to 89% similarity) | Mixed neighbors; two Invasive matches |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 2, 3, 7) · context · Lowers invasive score (-1.49); AI spot check 8/20 [F2] · Weak
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 4, 5, 6) · ↑ invasive · Raises invasive score (+0.51), but unreliable (3/20 spot check) [F3] · Unreliable
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 1, 5, 6) · ↑ invasive · Raises invasive score (+0.51), but unreliable (0/20 spot check) [F4] · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 5, 6) · ↑ invasive · Raises invasive score (+0.44); AI spot check 19/20 · Validated
- **Neoplastic cellularity** (regions 5, 6) · context · 5,277/mm² density (100th percentile) [F8], 74% tumor [F7], small nuclei [F9] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top 3 risk regions beats random deletion (+0.011, 95% CI 0.002 to 0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion CI -0.009 to 0.006 includes 0); case leans on unreliable necrosis, mitoses, and normal lobules.

## Could be wrong if
- High-risk heatmap regions 8 (85%), 9 (73%), or 4 (61%) contain focal stromal invasion diluted across 12 regions.
- Dense TILs (regions 2, 3, 7) obscure invasion, as in similar Invasive case BACH_0265 (89% similarity).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 8, 9, 4**: Highest heatmap invasive risk (85%, 73%, 61%); exclude stromal invasion beyond duct boundaries.
2. **Regions 5, 6**: Validated stromal-infiltration score, 100th-percentile tumor density, and variable nuclear size [F10]; verify intact myoepithelium.
3. **Regions 2, 3, 7**: Heavy TILs [F11] driving the non-invasive score; confirm inflammation does not mask microinvasion.
